name: Aluminium extrusions
description: 20 mm series T-slot and V-slot aluminium extrusions, cut to any length, and the slot nuts that go in them. Select sketch points first: each gets a rail or a nut. With nothing selected one stands on the origin.

slot.title: Slot
slot.description: T-slot is the MISUMI 5 series rail (HFS5, NFS5) with a 6 mm slot. V-slot is the OpenBuilds rail, whose slot faces are chamfered for wheels.

size.title: Size
size.description: Width and height in tens of millimetres: 2040 is 20 mm along the sketch X and 40 mm along Y. A V-slot comes as 2020 to 2080.

length.title: Length
length.description: How long the rail is cut.

end_taps.title: Tapped ends
end_taps.description: Taps the bores of an end M5, 12 mm deep, so a screw through another rail holds this one. Start is the end on the sketch point.

holes.title: Screw holes
holes.description: Optional. Where M5 screw holes go across the rail, as distances from the start in mm, such as 10, 290. Each is a 9.5 mm access hole through the lips and a 5.5 mm hole through the rest.

hole_face.title: Holes from
hole_face.description: The face the screws go in from: +Y and -Y are the two ends of the section's height, +X and -X of its width. A face with two slots gets a hole in each.

sketch.title: Sketch
sketch.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the point or circle you selected before opening this. To place by name instead, type the sketch name here and fill in Sketch point.

sketch_point.title: Sketch point
sketch_point.description: Optional. The id of a point or circle in that sketch, such as c1 or c1.center. Leave empty to use the selection.

type.title: Type
type.description: Pre-assembly is MISUMI HNTT5, 10 mm long, which slides in from the end of the rail. Post-assembly is MISUMI HNTP5, 17 mm long, which goes in through the slot and has a spring ball under it.

size.title: Size
size.description: The thread the nut is tapped with.

slot.title: Slot
slot.description: The rail the nut sits in. The nut hangs under the lips, 2 mm below the face of a T-slot and 1.8 mm below the face of a V-slot.

along.title: Rail runs along
along.description: The sketch axis the rail runs along, so the nut lies along the slot.

thread_modeled.title: Modeled thread
thread_modeled.description: On cuts the thread into the hole. Off drills the tap hole and lists the thread.

sketch.title: Sketch
sketch.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the point or circle you selected before opening this. To place by name instead, type the sketch name here and fill in Sketch point.

sketch_point.title: Sketch point
sketch_point.description: Optional. The id of a point or circle in that sketch, on the rail's face in the middle of a slot, such as c1 or c1.center. Leave empty to use the selection.
